side.notes: The exact photograph and taxonomic description constrain the slender caridean profile, toothed rostrum, six-somite abdomen, tapered telson, paired tail fan, stalked eyes, fine antennae and five walking-leg pairs.

top.uncertainty: Medium. The paper provides diagnostic structures and measured parts, but no calibrated live orthographic dorsal photograph was verified.
top.notes: Bilateral width, appendage splay and carapace taper remain conservative inferences rather than measured top-view contours.

front.uncertainty: Medium. Rostrum, eye and antennal seating are constrained by lateral and oblique evidence, not a calibrated frontal original.
front.notes: The backend keeps the body narrow, eyes paired and rostrum centered without claiming measured frontal precision.

silhouetteLandmarks.name: slender cephalothorax and six articulated abdominal somites
silhouetteLandmarks.notes: A narrow translucent carapace flows into six separately represented tapering pleomeres rather than a fish-shaped capsule.

silhouetteLandmarks.name: toothed median rostrum and stalked eyes
silhouetteLandmarks.notes: The rostrum extends forward over the paired eyes with small dorsal and ventral tooth cues, while the eyes remain on short stalks.

silhouetteLandmarks.name: five walking-leg pairs, five pleopod pairs and paired uropod fan
silhouetteLandmarks.notes: The appendage counts and tail-fan topology remain explicit, with small anterior chelae and stronger posterior walking legs.

proportions.name: upper adult body length
proportions.notes: The procedural body uses the upper end of the institutional 3 to 5 cm range; antennae remain outside the body-length measurement.

proportions.name: maximum body depth relative to body length
proportions.uncertainty: Medium. This is a conservative procedural ratio derived from live side-oblique silhouette and descriptive morphology, not a published total-body morphometric.
proportions.notes: The ratio keeps the shrimp slender while allowing a readable carapace and abdominal arch at game scale.

proportions.name: walking-leg and pleopod pair counts
proportions.notes: Five pereiopod pairs support benthic walking and grazing; five abdominal pleopod pairs support only brief repositioning swims.

colorPatternBoundaries.name: translucent grey-olive shell
colorPatternBoundaries.notes: The shell remains translucent and muted, with a subordinate internal warm cue instead of opaque cleaner-shrimp banding.

colorPatternBoundaries.name: broken reddish-brown lateral dots and dashes
colorPatternBoundaries.notes: Two irregular flank rows use discrete procedural marks; no source pixels or claimed sex-specific pattern rule are reproduced.

mismatches.note: No candidate, GLB or render exists. A later serialized build must verify the translucent shell, leg contact, rostrum readability, appendage clearance and six-somite silhouette.
Body width, eye separation and appendage splay remain inferred from descriptive and oblique evidence.
Setae, pleopod setules, exact rostral dentition and uropodal diaeresis are represented as restrained game-scale cues, not microscopic anatomy.

backendRepresentation.note: The dedicated species backend supplies the controls without reusing saltwater shrimp paint, oversized chelae or free-water hover behavior. Rendered acceptance remains downstream and explicit.
